tooltip.aquamarine.electric_scale: Dropped by the Storm Moray. Makes the Voltaic Coil and the Moray Whip.

tooltip.aquamarine.wither_harpoon_tip: Wither I for 8 s. No effect on the Kraken.
tooltip.aquamarine.shock_harpoon_tip: Discharge on wet targets within 6 blocks (50% damage). Kraken: +40% on the shield.
